name: player_select_and_resolve_preferred_pending_collision_contact
description: Player::SelectAndResolvePreferredPendingCollisionContact selects the preferred queued collision contact, resolves it, and marks preferred collision resolution for the frame.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player pending-contact source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x423fc0 validates saveState in ECX, selected contact initialized from preferredCollisionQueue.head, list walk through PlayerPendingContact::next at offset 0x44, repeated SelectPreferred(selected, current), ResolvePendingCollisionContact(saveState, selected), and preferredCollisionResolved set to 1.

The native smoke verifies that the function selects the lower approach-score contact, resolves it through the zero-normal early return path without clearing the queue, and sets preferredCollisionResolved.
